rules.title: The macOS system must disable guest login.
rules.fix_text: Run /usr/bin/defaults write /Library/Preferences/com.apple.loginwindow GuestEnabled -int 0 to disable the guest account.

ai.caution: Guests will no longer be able to log in.

rules.title: SIP must be enabled.
rules.fix_text: Boot to Recovery and run /usr/bin/csrutil enable.
